name: Integer-Stride Preview Subsampling
definition: A method to generate low-resolution volume previews by subsampling the source volume using integer strides along each axis (Z, Y, X). It preserves exact original physical voxel positions by adjusting spacing while keeping origin and direction unchanged. It is intended for navigation and rapid overview, not diagnostic quality.
summary: Integer-Stride Preview Subsampling generates fast, low-resolution volume previews using nearest-neighbour subsampling, preserving physical positions for navigation but lacking diagnostic quality.
